bundle.shortDescription: Read the stones, approve the drafts, watch the proofs.
bundle.longDescription: Cairn is a feature registry for agent-assisted development. The desktop app is where a human reads the drafts a mason raised, follows the proofs a warden wrote, and decides what to do with an escalation.
